signals.usability_note: House is visible in the mid-ground behind a row of young arborvitae; the frontage is partially obscured by shrubs and a road sign in the foreground.

yard_sign.detail: The only sign is a roadside traffic/object marker (yellow and black chevron), not a real estate or contractor sign.

professional_landscaping.evidence: There is a uniformly planted row of arborvitae over a mulched bed with a stone border, but no crew or other crew-level evidence is visible.

signals.notes: This is a large two-and-a-half-story home with a stone-pillared front porch and a circular driveway, set well back from the road behind a hedge row; the gravel strip in the foreground has some weeds.
